author: Aletheia II
title: Dual-Path with Conformer-Style Backbone
abstract: This experiment proposes a fundamental improvement to the dual-path architecture by replacing the purely convolutional backbone with a Conformer-style backbone. Each block in the new backbone consists of a sequence of modules: a feed-forward network, a multi-head self-attention module, a convolutional module, and another feed-forward network, with residual connections. This design is hypothesized to create a more powerful feature extractor by learning both local positional and global content-based relationships at each layer of the network, leading to a significant performance improvement.

import sys
sys.path.append('storage/aletheia')

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random, lax
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

# --- Hyperparameters ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001, 'd_model': 128, 'num_blocks': 4,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1, 'gru_hidden_size': 128, 'hidden_dim': 512,
        'num_attn_heads': 4, 'cnn_kernel_size': 7
    }

# --- Conformer Block Components ---
class FeedForward(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        h = nn.Dense(features=self.d_model * 2)(h)
        h = nn.swish(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        h = nn.Dense(features=self.d_model)(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        return h

class ConformerBlock(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # FFN -> Self-Attention -> Conv -> FFN
        ff1 = FeedForward(d_model=self.hparams['d_model'], dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])
        x = x + 0.5 * ff1(x, deterministic)

        sa = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.hparams['num_attn_heads'], dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        x = x + sa(h, deterministic=deterministic)

        conv = nn.Conv(features=self.hparams['d_model'], kernel_size=(self.hparams['cnn_kernel_size'],), padding='SAME')
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        h = nn.swish(conv(h))
        x = x + nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(h, deterministic=deterministic)

        ff2 = FeedForward(d_model=self.hparams['d_model'], dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])
        x = x + 0.5 * ff2(x, deterministic)

        return nn.LayerNorm()(x)

# --- Main Dual-Path Model ---
class ConformerDualPath(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Conformer Backbone
        h = nn.Dense(self.hparams['d_model'])(x)
        for _ in range(self.hparams['num_blocks']):
            h = ConformerBlock(hparams=self.hparams)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        cnn_features = h

        # 2. Dual Path (same as SOTA model)
        mean_pooled = jnp.mean(cnn_features, axis=1)
        max_pooled = jnp.max(cnn_features, axis=1)
        pooled_features = jnp.concatenate([mean_pooled, max_pooled], axis=-1)

        fwd_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        bwd_rnn = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        initial_carry = jnp.zeros((x.shape[0], self.hparams['gru_hidden_size']))
        fwd_gru_seq = fwd_rnn(cnn_features, initial_carry=initial_carry)
        bwd_gru_seq = bwd_rnn(jnp.flip(cnn_features, axis=1), initial_carry=initial_carry)
        bigru_outputs = jnp.concatenate([fwd_gru_seq, jnp.flip(bwd_gru_seq, axis=1)], axis=-1)
        
        query_token = self.param('query_token', nn.initializers.normal(), (1, 1, bigru_outputs.shape[-1]))
        query_token_batch = jnp.tile(query_token, (x.shape[0], 1, 1))
        attn_output = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.hparams['num_attn_heads'])(
            inputs_q=query_token_batch, inputs_kv=bigru_outputs, deterministic=deterministic)
        recurrent_features = attn_output.squeeze(axis=1)

        projected_recurrent = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_model'], name="RecurrentProjection")(recurrent_features)
        projected_pooled = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_model'], name="PooledProjection")(pooled_features)
        combined_features = jnp.concatenate([projected_recurrent, projected_pooled], axis=-1)

        # 3. Prediction Head
        z = nn.LayerNorm()(combined_features)
        z = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['hidden_dim'])(z)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(features=self.hparams['d_output'])(z)

        if self.hparams['task_type'] == 'regression' and self.hparams['d_output'] == 1:
            return logits.squeeze(-1)
        return logits

class Wrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams): self.network = ConformerDualPath(hparams=hparams)
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        p_key, d_key = random.split(rng_key)
        return self.network.init({'params': p_key, 'dropout': d_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)['params']
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
      rngs = {}
      if not deterministic:
          if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
          rngs['dropout'] = rng_key
      return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs=rngs)

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
  return Wrapper(hparams=hparams)
